data.message: Hey Charlie, just passing through on my way to weapons!

I found Bob's body in security just now. My path this round was storage, lower engine, upper engine, medbay, electrical, and then security. Earlier on, I saw Eve and Diana in upper engine. More recently, around tick 16 and 17, I saw Charlie moving from medbay into electrical. Charlie, you were in electrical right before me — did you see anyone head towards security or weapons? I'd like to hear everyone's whereabouts before we make any decisions.

My path was medbay, electrical, medbay, upper engine, and then back to medbay. Alice is right, I saw her and Eve in upper engine around tick 13. I saw Alice leave towards medbay right after. 

One thing that stands out to me: way earlier, around tick 6, I saw Frank enter electrical coming from the direction of security, which is where Bob's body was found. Frank, was Bob alive when you were in security? Later on, I saw Frank again in upper engine around tick 15 and 16.

Also, Alice mentioned seeing Charlie move from medbay to electrical around tick 16 or 17, but I actually saw Charlie in medbay at tick 18 right before the meeting was called. 

I'm just putting my timeline out there for everyone. Let's hear from Frank and Charlie to clear up these timings.

My path this round was starting in security, then moving to electrical, medbay, and finally upper engine. 

To answer your question Diana: yes, I was in security very early on, but I didn't see Bob or a body when I left around tick 6. Bob must have been killed sometime after I headed to electrical. Since Alice just found the body recently, the kill likely happened way after I was gone.

I can confirm Diana's path as well. I saw her in medbay around tick 10 and 11, and we crossed paths in upper engine around tick 15 before she headed back to medbay at tick 16. 

Given Alice found the body in security, whoever was on the right side of the map recently is our prime suspect. I'd like to hear from Charlie and Eve to figure out where they were, especially since there's a discrepancy about where Charlie was around tick 16 to 18. I think we need more info before voting.

I can back up some of the timelines we've heard so far. My path was electrical, medbay, upper engine, and then I went down to lower engine. 

I can confirm I saw Alice in upper engine from tick 11 to 13, and Diana arrived there from medbay around tick 13. Since my path kept me on the left side of the map towards the end of the round, I haven't been near security at all recently, so I have no information on Bob's body. 

Right now, it seems like the timeline around Charlie is the most important thing to figure out. Charlie, since you're speaking next, please clear up where you were between ticks 16 and 18, and let us know if you saw anyone heading toward security. 

Since we still need Charlie's information and I don't have a clear suspect based on my own vision, I think skipping is the safest choice for now.

Alright, let me clear up the discrepancy first because both Alice and Diana are actually correct. My path this round was navigation, then up through storage, into medbay, and then I've been bouncing between medbay and electrical doing wiring tasks. So yes, Alice — you saw me move from medbay to electrical around tick 16 or 17, that was me. And Diana, you saw me back in medbay at tick 18 because I returned to finish another medbay task. Both of those sightings are consistent with my route.

For witnesses on my end: I saw Alice leave medbay heading to electrical at tick 16, and then leave electrical heading toward security at tick 17. Alice, that's consistent with what you said. I also saw Diana enter medbay from upper engine at tick 18 and then leave to cafeteria right before the meeting was called.

Here's what concerns me though. Frank, you admitted you were in security early. Bob was killed in security. You say you didn't see a body when you left at tick 6 — but Bob being alive doesn't mean someone wasn't already there waiting, or that you weren't the last person with him. The fact that nobody can vouch for what happened in security early on is a real gap.

That said, I never went near security myself this round, so I can't pinpoint the killer with certainty. I'd lean toward Frank based on opportunity, but I'm open to skipping if people aren't convinced. Skipping is reasonable given how thin the evidence is.

I just found Alice dead in security. Guys, I'm extremely confident it's Charlie. I was in weapons, and I saw Charlie walk into weapons coming directly from security. As soon as I went into security right after him, Alice's body was just sitting there. Eve was in weapons with me and saw Charlie come from there too. Charlie is the duck, no doubt about it.

Whoa, slow down Diana — that's a very confident accusation and the timeline doesn't add up. Yes, I was in security, I'm not going to lie about that. I came from navigation, passed through, and moved to weapons. But Alice wasn't dead when I left — I would have reported immediately if she was. 

Think about what you just said: you "saw me walk into weapons from security," then you "went into security right after" and found Alice dead. That means YOU were the next person in that room after me. If I had just killed her, why would I walk straight into weapons where you and Eve were sitting? That's the worst possible play for a duck. 

What's much more likely: Alice was alive when I left security, you followed me in, killed her, and now you're self-reporting with a clean alibi pointing at me. Classic duck move — frame the last person seen in the room.

Eve, I really need you to be careful here. Did you actually SEE me come from the security corridor, or did Diana tell you that after the fact? Because Diana finding the body right after I leave is the most convenient setup I've ever heard. I'm voting Diana.

Charlie, your defense doesn't hold up. You're claiming Diana followed you into security and killed Alice, but that's impossible. 

Diana and I were ALREADY together in weapons at tick 22. You walked into weapons from security at tick 23. Diana was with me the whole time before you arrived, so she couldn't have killed Alice. She only left weapons to go into security AFTER you got to us, which is when she found the body. 

Since Diana has a rock-solid alibi with me, and you were the last one in security before she found the body, it has to be you. 

Frank, vote Charlie with us. This is a closed case.

I didn't see any of this happen since I've been on the complete opposite side of the ship this round. After the last meeting, my route was electrical to medbay and then up to upper engine, and I literally haven't seen a single soul. 

Charlie, your defense makes sense in a vacuum, but Eve's testimony is the nail in the coffin. Since there's only one Duck in this game, Eve and Diana can't both be Ducks. For your story to be true, either Eve is lying to frame you (which makes no sense if Diana is the one initiating the accusation), or Diana is the Duck and somehow tricked Eve. But Eve is explicitly stating that Diana was with her in weapons *before* you arrived, meaning Diana couldn't have killed Alice in security right before reporting. 

Given that Eve is hard-clearing Diana's timeline, the only logical conclusion is that you are the Duck, Charlie. I'm trusting Eve's confirmation here. I'm voting Charlie.

Charlie
Charlie

Okay, everyone, listen carefully because this vote is about to lose you the game.

Eve, I want to ask you one specific question: did you have eyes on Diana *every single second* from tick 19 to tick 23? Not "we were both in weapons" — actually watching her. Because weapons connects directly to security. It takes seconds to step out, kill, and step back in. If you so much as turned around to fake a task, Diana had a window.

And Frank — think about this. Diana is the one who "conveniently" found the body. Diana is the one who walked into security right after me and immediately rang the bell with a pre-loaded accusation. That's textbook self-report behavior. Eve is corroborating *presence*, not *innocence*. Those are different things.

My route was navigation to security to weapons. I saw Bob earlier in security at tick 6 — he's now dead too. I didn't kill Alice. If you eject me, the next round you'll find another body and realize Diana played you.

I know how this looks. The last person in the room is the easy vote. But the easy vote is exactly what a duck wants you to take. I'm voting Diana. Please, at least consider skipping if you're not 100% sure — a wrong eject here ends the game.

Charlie, your desperation is showing. I had eyes on Diana in weapons at both tick 22 and 23. She didn't leave my sight to slip into security. Furthermore, if she had somehow killed Alice before tick 22, you would have tripped over the body when you were passing through security right before walking into weapons at tick 23. The timeline leaves absolutely no room for anyone but you to be the Duck. You had the only opportunity, and your attempts to cast doubt on Diana aren't working. I'm not second-guessing what I saw.

I hear your defense, Charlie, and in a lot of games, you'd be right about the "last person in the room" getting framed. But your entire argument relies on Diana slipping away from Eve to get the kill, and Eve is shutting that down completely. 

Eve has no reason to lie and hard-clear Diana if Eve is a Goose. Since there's only one Duck left in this game, Diana and Eve can't be working together as Ducks. Eve's confirmation that she had eyes on Diana in weapons at ticks 22 and 23 makes your theory impossible. If Diana had stepped out into security to kill Alice, Eve would have noticed. And if Diana killed Alice before you got there, you would have seen the body when you walked through.

The math just doesn't work out for anyone but you being the Duck here. I'm trusting Eve's timeline. My vote stays on you.

Charlie
